page: Microsoft Azure DC16eds_v6 is a virtual machine instance belonging to the DCEDV6 server family. It is built on the x86_64 CPU architecture and features 16 dedicated vCPUs powered by an Intel processor, running on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of system memory, yielding a ratio of 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

This server type includes 945 GB of local disk storage and is premium storage capable, allowing for high-performance disk configurations. It does not include any integrated GPU hardware or complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

Given its balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio and substantial local storage capacity, the DC16eds_v6 is suitable for database workloads, general-purpose enterprise applications, and local data processing tasks. Its dedicated CPU allocation ensures consistent performance without resource contention, offering a stable hardware profile for workloads requiring reliable compute and local storage capacity.
